 By Natalie Olafson Published on November 01, 2026 Source: Google Street View Cincinnati is heading into a mild Sunday, with mostly cloudy skies and a high near 73 degrees. The day should stay largely dry, offering a comfortable window for errands, brunch or outdoor plans before rain chances return after dark.
 Sunday Stays Warm And Mostly Cloudy
 Sunday’s high is near 71 degrees, with southeast winds at 3 mph. The chance of rain remains low during the day, around 4%. Showers are expected to develop in the evening, according to the National Weather Service .
 The showers are expected to continue overnight.
 Showers Arrive After 7 P.M.
 A chance of rain showers develops after 7 p.m. Sunday, with cloudy skies and a low near 53. The rain chance rises to about 40%, though expected rainfall remains light, with new amounts generally below a tenth of an inch.
 Monday could begin with a few showers before noon, followed by mostly cloudy skies and a high near 68. Winds will remain light from the southeast, so the main inconvenience for commuters and early outdoor plans will be wet pavement rather than a major storm.
 Warm Tuesday Gives Way To A Wetter Midweek
 Tuesday looks like the week’s warmest day, reaching near 78 degrees under mostly sunny skies. Rain chances increase Tuesday night, then become much more substantial Wednesday as showers move in and a slight chance of thunderstorms develops.
 Wednesday’s high should reach about 73, with rain expected Wednesday and likely Wednesday night. Additional chances for rain linger Thursday and Friday before Saturday turns partly sunny with a high near 65, and no watches, warnings or advisories are currently posted for the Cincinnati area.
